description: Java class implementing a simplified version of SHA1 pseudo-random number generator, used for key derivation with insecure practices, deprecated on Android.

classes.name: InsecureSHA1PRNGKeyDerivator
classes.description: A class providing insecure SHA1-based key derivation functions, including seed setting and byte generation.

methods.name: deriveInsecureKey
methods.description: Public static method to derive a key from a seed byte array with specified length.

methods.name: updateSeed
methods.description: Updates internal seed state with new bytes, affecting hash computation.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Overrides seed setting to incorporate new seed bytes into internal state.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Generates random bytes based on internal seed and counter, using SHA1 hash.

methods.name: computeHash
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash over a 512-bit message block stored in an int array.

methods.name: updateHash
methods.description: Appends bytes to the hash input buffer and computes hash when full.
